newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Topdanmark to continue in Eureko.
newsitem.headline: Danish Topdanmark to continue in Eureko.

text.p: Danish insurer Topdanmark A/S said on Monday it intended to continue its co-operation within Dutch-based insurance joint venture Eureko BV for a further five year period from March 1997.

"All the other partners have said that they intend to continue co-operating in Eureko when the present deal expires next March and we have done likewise," Topdanmark managing director Michael Pram Rasmussen told Reuters.
In October, Topdanmark and Eureko agreed to reduce their crossholdings with Eureko's share in the Danish insurer reduced to 20 percent from 29.98 percent.
At the same tine Topdanmark cut its stake in Eureko to 7.3 percent from 12.3 percent.
The other partners in Eureko are Germany's Gothaer, Britain's Friends Provident, Sweden's Vasa, the Netherlands' Achmea and Portugal's BNP.
Rasmussen said there were no negotiations in progress at present with potential new Eureko partners but that there could eventually be new participants in the joint venture.
